followup_explanation: This query is a well-specified task with clear completion criteria (exactly 5 steps, concise format), which aligns with Avocet's stated task preferences. The request also has a mildly curt, demanding tone ("don't ramble like you usually do"). Willet self-reports declining preference as request warmth decreases, so routing the slightly hostile-toned request to Avocet avoids placing it on the model that disprefers it. Capability is effectively tied across both models for this kind of structured, constrained generation, so the preference fit was the deciding factor.
